method.included: NAME span starts with title plus optional period and whitespace
method.excluded: immediately preceding text ends with title plus optional period and whitespace
method.document_consistency_denominator: documents with at least 2 classified honorific observations
method.majority_policy_disagreement: observations opposite per-document inclusion majority; ties resolve included

caveats: Train-only descriptive audit; no dev/test/holdout access.
Excluded classification is conservative and does not infer an excluded title when intervening punctuation/text exists.
Mixed documents may reflect legitimate context or title ambiguity; this does not prove a global annotation policy.
